name: prev_day_hl_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY closes above its previous day high (PDH) for three consecutive 5-second bars, overnight short-sellers' stop orders clustered just above PDH have been swept, removing the supply ceiling and creating a micro-liquidity vacuum. Simultaneously, breakout-scanning algorithms (dozens of which monitor PDH/PDL on NIFTY in real time) detect the confirmed level breach and inject fresh buy orders, accelerating the index 15-30 spot points beyond PDH within 30-90 seconds before the first wave of mean-reversion algos absorbs momentum. The symmetric logic applies at PDL for bearish breaks: trapped longs exit, shorts pile in, and the first 15-25 spot point decline is the most momentum-rich phase. PDH/PDL on NIFTY carries more weight than on individual stocks because every market participant — retail, institutional, FII — uses the same reference level for the same index.
core_signal_oneliner: Previous day high/low breakout confirmed by 3-bar (15s) persistence, 20-min relative volume > 1.5x, and VWAP directional alignment
